setup.result: Confirmed TP-1621 -> id 48300 (record_status active, test_runs_count {active:0, closed:0}) and TP-1616 -> id 48283 (record_status active, test_runs_count {active:1, closed:0}, sub_plans_count:14, more active plan).

probe.item_shape: data.trend_data is a genuinely empty array (no elements) — point shape (positional array vs keyed object) cannot be observed. data.state_distribution is a zero-padded keyed object ({active:0, closed:0}); data.session_outcomes is a zero-padded empty keyed object ({}); data.total_count is a scalar (0).

notes: Required params: project_id and test_plan_id, both integer path params, both required. No query params, no paging, no date window (per describeCapability guidance).

Declared success schema for the payload: `data` is a bare `{type: object}` with NO properties enumerated at all — this is the 'unfalsifiable {type:object}' pattern: any object technically satisfies it, so nothing the API returns inside `data` can be checked against the schema as missing OR extra in a meaningful sense. Every field actually returned (total_count, state_distribution, session_outcomes, trend_data) is technically 'undeclared' only because the schema declares zero properties, not because of a real contract violation.

THE DECISIVE CHECK for this chart capability could not be resolved. The response IS structured as an object (not an array) at the top of `data`, and one sub-field (state_distribution) IS zero-padded with keyed {active:0, closed:0} rather than positional pairs — that part looks like the 'gets it right' side (cf. get_test_case_count_trend). BUT the field that would actually answer the family's split question — trend_data, which is presumably the time-series chart array — came back as a genuinely EMPTY array ([]), not a zero-padded array of placeholder points. Per instructions, a genuinely empty (non-zero-padded) payload for the decisive field means the positional-vs-object question for trend_data's data points cannot be checked here, so this is marked UNVERIFIED rather than PASS or DRIFT on that specific question.

Consistent with the sibling probe's finding that 0 exploratory sessions exist in this project (and two others sampled): total_count is 0, session_outcomes is an empty object, and trend_data is an empty array — there is no session data anywhere in the plan (TP-1616 / id 48283, the more active plan with 1 active test run and 14 sub-plans) to populate the chart with real points.

Only one invocation attempt was needed; it returned 200 on the first try against project 379335744 / plan id 48283 (TP-1616). The __readonly__ plan TP-1621 (id 48300) was resolved via list_test_plans_by_integer_id but not separately invoked, since the first call already succeeded cleanly and a second call against an equally-empty plan would not add information toward the decisive (positional-vs-object) check.
No error responses were encountered (BLOCKED not applicable); this was a clean 200 on the first attempt, so no error body was diffed against the success schema.
